title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy carries an obsolete or removed directive
description: The Content-Security-Policy contains a directive that current browsers do not implement. Reviewers reading the policy count the directive as a control, while the browser ignores it, so the policy overstates what it enforces and the replacement control may never have been configured.
risk: The policy appears to enforce a control that no browser applies; LOW severity because the missing protection is a gap, not an active weakness.
